slides.title: 5 bedtime phrases
slides.voiceover: Five calm phrases for bedtime battles. Save this for tonight.

slides.name: Name the feeling
slides.say: I can see you are not ready to stop playing. It is hard to end fun time. It is still time for [BEDTIME ACTIVITY].
slides.voiceover: First, name the feeling. Then hold the limit kindly.

slides.name: Offer two choices
slides.say: Do you want to brush teeth first, or pick the [BOOK]? You choose, then we head to bed.
slides.voiceover: Give two choices, both of which lead to bed.

slides.name: Preview what's next
slides.say: After the story, lights go off, and I will give you a [HUG OR KISS]. Then it is sleepy time.
slides.voiceover: Preview what comes next so nothing feels like a surprise.

slides.name: Calm reassurance
slides.say: You are safe. I am right here in the house. I will check on you at [TIME] if you need me.
slides.voiceover: Reassure them that you are close and they are safe.

slides.name: Warm goodnight
slides.say: I love our [FAVORITE PART OF DAY]. Sleep well. See you in the morning.
slides.voiceover: End on connection with a warm, short goodnight.
